snippet.title: Rebellious Takeover | Wishlist Announcement
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4296510/Rebellious_Takeover/

Deren hates proprietary screws. Lyra loves attention. We are finally live on Steam. All good things, I hope.

Obligatory algorithm stuff:

Rebellious Takeover is a game available on Steam that is being worked on by vecShift Studios. It is a beat-em-up/visual novel mix game and stars a group of rebels in a tech store trying to fight Veritas Industries, the current government body in the games story location, Nexon. The game was originally conceptualised in 2025 and has been in development since.
